scoring_rules.json.scientific_requirements: Score independent final scientific propositions only, with fixed all-or-zero weights totaling 100. Intermediate geometries, state calculations, software execution, process records and report completeness earn no separate points. Require genuine linked native calculations or reproducible data analysis appropriate to each claim; validate chemical identity, state, reference, units and conditions first. A supplied observation or disclosed target alone earns no credit. Numeric windows are inclusive and unchanged; hard-window failure, wrong identity/reference, missing evidence and unsupported guesses fail. Equivalent established explanations pass directly. need_review is available only for the specific unresolved substantive scientific conflicts listed on a reviewable final item; it is not a pass and cannot excuse missing evidence or hard numerical failure. AR chooses its method. PR retains the disclosed baseline and must substantiate any applicable substitution. Judge each independent proposition without invalidating other supported conclusions.

tolerance_policy.basis: Semantic-only: the task asks association topology and explanatory reach. Atomic mapping for published Fig4 scalar quantities is insufficient for a defensible numeric target, so no invented tolerance is used. ExactSI/native electronic agreement supports structural comparability but is not rewarded as a raw absolute-energy target. Independent topology and relative packing are falsifiable using actual coordinates.

historical_qualification.retained_scientific_limitations: Fig4 CB8 numbers4.10/3.72Angstrom,70.54degrees are not reproduced by consistently mapped SI coordinates; nine geometry definitions were tested. Source SI same-definition centroid is3.77413775Angstrom, calculation3.77472709. D3 damping was unspecified; uniform source-supported BJ reconstruction is retained. Native Hessian restart completedCB8 after an interrupted parent, not a nonexistent successful originalFreq. No emission wavelengths, uniqueH/J sign, CT dominance or full kinetics are certified. Host optical concentration is unresolved across source locations: main article pp5-6 and Figure 6 describe G1 0.02 mM, whereas official SI Table S1 labels the 445 nm CB7:G1 and 526 nm CB8:G1(2) rows G1 0.50 mM. These are conflicting labels for the reported host spectra, not two independently measured concentration series. A source-labelled within-branch comparison is allowed; do not treat a mixed-source comparison as concentration matched.
